name: recruit-match-suite-fast
description: A fast HR recruitment suite on DingTalk AI Table. Deterministic work (parsing, dedupe, batch writes, attachments, scoring, statistics) runs inside bundled zero-dependency Python scripts in batches; the agent spends compute only on one batched semantic judgement per pipeline. Same business rules as recruit-match-suite, an order of magnitude fewer agent turns.
descriptionEn: A fast HR recruitment suite on DingTalk AI Table. Deterministic work (parsing, dedupe, batch writes, attachments, scoring, statistics) runs inside bundled zero-dependency Python scripts in batches; the agent spends compute only on one batched semantic judgement per pipeline.
descriptionZh: 基于钉钉 AI 表格的 HR 招聘智能匹配套件·极速版。解析、查重、批量落库、附件上传、评分与岗位统计全部由自带零依赖 Python 脚本批量完成，AI 只在批量语义判定这一个回合用算力；业务口径与老版完全一致，agent 回合数与端到端耗时下降一个量级。
